name: Le Petit Chaperon Rouge
source: A group of high school students go on school trip in the forest to work on a play based on “The Little Red Riding Hood”. They occupie an old abandoned house. Everything goes well until some strange events occur: Ludivine is found dead in the forest nearby the house. A murderer hides within the group of students and does not seem to want to stop the murders. The wolf started to kill…
